review_notes: Read the whole target (one theorem) and the imported LocalAutomorphismODEGroup.lean, which has a near-verbatim copy of the proof. Checked the use sites: OneParameterLocalODE.lean:86 uses the contDiffAt version, and OneParameterGeneratorAdd.lean:48 uses the analytic version. Found no other duplication inside the target. I did not check that the proposed refactor compiles. It needs the target theorem moved before its analytic wrapper, or the wrapper moved here, because of the import direction. I did not check whether the moved declarations have other importers that would be affected.

findings.problem: The entire proof, from the ε-selection through ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Ioo to the final rewriting (about 45 lines), is duplicated almost character for character. The other copy is the proof of local_automorphism_ODE_group_law in LocalAutomorphismODEGroup.lean (lines 60–114). The only difference is that the analytic version first derives `hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 X p.val` from `AnalyticOnNhd ℂ X U`. The target already has `hX : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 X p.val`, so it is the general statement. The rest of the proof is the group-law argument: uniform small-time bounds, the shifted solution t ↦ g(u+t)x versus t ↦ g(u)(g t x), and Lipschitz ODE uniqueness. That argument is maintained twice, and the two copies can drift apart.
findings.proposed_change: Keep one copy of the proof, in the general contDiffAt form. Because LocalAutomorphismODEGroup2 imports LocalAutomorphismODEGroup, the existing direction cannot simply be reversed. Either (a) move `local_automorphism_ODE_group_law_of_contDiffAt` into LocalAutomorphismODEGroup.lean directly after `ambientAut_uniform_at_zero` and shrink `local_automorphism_ODE_group_law` to `local_automorphism_ODE_group_law_of_contDiffAt hU hc p X ((hX p.val p.property).contDiffAt.restrict_scalars ℝ) g hg0 hr hδ hball hgc hd`, or (b) move the analytic version into LocalAutomorphismODEGroup2.lean as that one-line corollary. Both statements keep their current hypotheses (hU, LocallyCompactSpace U, hc, hball, hgc, hd). Both users, OneParameterGeneratorAdd.lean and OneParameterLocalODE.lean, keep working unchanged, since they import the module that holds both names.
findings.benefit: This removes a duplicated 45-line proof that is the core of the local group-law result. A future change to the ε bookkeeping or the ODE comparison is then made once, and a reader sees one proof plus an explicit 'analytic ⇒ C¹' corollary.
